newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts trading in banks, finance.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts trading in banks, finance.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange said on Monday that it had halted trading in all finance and banking shares with immediate effect pending a statement from the central bank and the finance ministry.
The bourse said in a statement that it had halted trading because the expected statement could have an impact on share prices of both sectors.
The statement would deal with some measures to strengthen the stability of Thai financial institutions, it added.
The trading halt follows news over the weekend that two major Thai financial institutions, Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank, planned a merger.

The planned merger between the largest Thai finance company and the medium sized bank has yet to be confirmed by the two companies. They were expected to spell out the details at a joint conference later, brokers said.

The central bank and finance ministry statement was expected to be connected to the news of this merger, which would be the biggest shake-out in the finance sector in over a decade if it goes through.
